The likely mispricing is not simply “oil up”; it is that non-Hormuz barrels, low-cost producers, tanker/security-linked beneficiaries, and select defense/logistics names may see estimate revisions while consensus models still fade oil prices and margins back toward pre-shock assumptions within one to two quarters.
